eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: Most of the villagers evacuated to the next town.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: Someone has to rebuild this place, so I'm doing it.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: I'm too old to evacuate with the others.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: The vines will grow back. They always do.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: We salvage every beam that didn't burn.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: The inn goes up first. People need somewhere to sleep.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: Rume is heading the restoration effort, so I figure I'll lend a hand

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: This frame is new. The rest is still on the ground.

eventRows.speaker: This
eventRows.text: M-my artifacts... a-all buried under there...
